script.text: Now that the Pharaoh saved the world, there was one last thing he had to do – move on to the afterlife.

Guided by Marik, Ishizu, and Odion, the team went to a sacred underground temple that housed the gateway to the afterlife. To open the door, the Pharaoh had to seal away the Egyptian God Cards and the seven Millennium Items... and have one final duel. A ritual duel against Yugi.
The duel would determine whether Yugi could now stand on his own as his own man and not need the Pharaoh's help anymore.
This is the first time in my life that I have hoped for my opponent’s victory.
But in order for this duel to truly test our readiness to separate, I must fight with all of my strength.
Pharaoh, now that you’ve left the Millennium Puzzle, I can’t hear your thoughts anymore. But somehow, I still know what you’re thinking. And I feel the same way.
If you taught me anything, it’s to put your heart into your deck and duel with everything you’ve got. That’s exactly what I’m gonna do!
